svg.title: GPU inference optimization swarm · Complete Codex / third-party agent workflow
svg.desc: Reorganized from four workflow screenshots. Includes human gates, three coordinating roles, four H200/B200 deployment forms, the Phase 0–5 optimization loop, 21 expert roles in six groups, five validation levels, knowledge assets, and Skill Hub distribution and reuse. Agent roles are performed by Codex or third-party agents. Publication and reuse illustrate a conceptual process, not completed implementation.
svg.metadata: Hardware references: https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/h200/ ; https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/dgx-b200/ ; https://docs.nvidia.com/cuda/blackwell-tuning-guide/ . Reorganized from image001.png–image004.png; created 2026-10-08.

g.text: GPU inference optimization swarm · Complete workflow
Codex / third-party agents × H200 / B200 × Layered validation × Knowledge capture × Skill Hub
Org L0 · Human engineers / Review gates
Define goals and system boundaries; approve numerical, concurrency, and production-risk changes; retain final review authority.
Goals and constraints / Approval of critical changes
Codex / third-party agents can switch roles by task and dispatch experts as needed.
Task breakdown / Expert dispatch / Iteration state
Coordination and arbitration → Task DAG / Board
AGENTS.md / Skill knowledge + GPU capability model
Cost and benefit → Roadmap / Priorities / Hypotheses
Register experiments / Control variables / Audit evidence
One question per experiment → Plan / Attribution
Target hardware · NVIDIA H200 / B200 | Four deployment forms, each with a configuration record
HBM / Kernel fusion / KV cache / Quantization
CUDA Graph / Triton / Batch and sequence
Memory / Comm overlap / PD colocated or split
NCCL / RDMA / KV transfer / Topology mapping
Hardware capabilities + Workload profile → Optimization inputs
Measure compute, HBM, and interconnects; record GPU, driver, CUDA, NCCL, and engine versions.
Outputs: capability cards, topology, workloads; reuse validated configs for matching deployments.
Run a working version → Freeze data, model, workload → Collect E2E SLOs, accuracy, and full traces.
Trace Analyst + Microbenchmark → Rank bottlenecks by throughput loss → Optimization Planner.
Phase 3 · Optimization loop (core; supports nested parallel work)
Bottlenecks + AGENTS.md / Skills → Candidate hypotheses with expected benefits and risks.
Controller links each hypothesis to variables, code, and evidence; one question at a time.
Dispatch kernel, parallelism, comm, engine, quantization, memory experts; isolate branches/resources.
Optimize CUDA / Triton / CUTLASS, NCCL, KV cache, CUDA Graph, etc. for measured bottlenecks.
Flag critical numerical, concurrency, or production-risk changes for human approval.
Operator correctness / Microbench / Isolated scenarios: test Prefill, KV Transfer, Decode separately.
Failure → Return to 3.1 with attribution; proceed to full validation only after local checks pass.
Eval sets + Per-request output diffs → Accuracy; real workloads → Throughput, latency, stability.
Confirm local gains translate to E2E gains: microbench speedup ≠ service improvement.
Accuracy Guardian: regressions; Reliability Auditor: stability and fault injection.
Release Guard: risk list → Human approval of critical changes → Canary rollout with rollback.
Accept against real workloads and SLOs; record regressions, applicability, and rollback plans.
Experience Curator updates AGENTS.md / Skills / Swarm Skills; archives configs, evidence, failures.
Continuous production monitoring → Return to Phase 2 for the next iteration (outer loop).
Codex / third-party agents activate roles on demand, in parallel if needed.
Org L3 · Frequent feedback / Layered validation
For each change, choose the smallest check that answers the question.
Gate: pass validation L0–L2 before L3–L4.
Prefill / KV Transfer / Decode / Long context
L3 Model accuracy · Minutes to hours
Eval sets / Per-request output diffs / Acceptable error
Real workloads / TTFT / TPOT / Throughput / Stability
Link feedback to the problem, hypothesis, code, GPU, workload, evidence.
Verify benchmark gains in real services; time scales are illustrative.
Org L4 · Knowledge assets + Shared memory (reuse across roles and sessions)
Promotion rules · Match the scope of reuse
New lessons → AGENTS.md; stable, repeated practice → Skill.
Stable multi-role workflow → Swarm Skill; capture once, reuse widely.
Record GPU/software versions, workload, preconditions, gains, and evidence.
Knowledge gates · Keep unsupported claims out
Every asset needs traceable evidence, applicability limits, and reproduction steps.
Validate gains at the level the claim requires; release claims must cover L3–L4.
Archive failed hypotheses as counterexamples; do not promote untested guesses.
Org L5 · Skill Hub (capture once, reuse globally)
Publish validated Skills / Swarm Skills as installable capability packs for Codex / third-party agents.
1 Package Swarm Skill, sub-skills, and collaboration roles
2 Self-check: evidence, experiment archive, data redaction
3 Create a Skill Hub entry or submit the capability pack
4 Set name, description, version, tags, GPU compatibility
5 Upload package, README, dependencies, reproduction guide
6 Publish after review; maintain version and rollback history
Include: GPU config templates / Evidence / Lessons
Exclude: secrets / Internal URLs / Private data / Project memory
1 Search Skill Hub for GPU inference optimization packs
2 Install into the Codex / third-party agent skills directory
3 Check and install dependencies from dependencies.yaml
4 Supply environment credentials and define target SLOs
5 Run Phase 0 to map local GPUs and workloads
6 Run the full loop; validate and select a matching config
Reuse methods and evidence; revalidate on local hardware.
Loop 1: local failure / revision → 3.1 Loop 2: production monitoring → Phase 2 Loop 3: prior lessons → 3.1 / Hub reuse → Phase 0
GPU scope: H200 focuses on BF16 / FP16 / FP8; assess FP4 / NVFP4 on B200 where supported. Capabilities depend on hardware and software.
Sources: four original workflow screenshots; NVIDIA H200, DGX B200, Blackwell Tuning Guide. Skill Hub illustrates a generic distribution layer.
